company.name: voize
company.description:
voize, founded in 2020, develops the leading voice-powered AI assistant for the care sector. It enables nurses and caregivers to document care in real time, right at the patient’s bedside. By reducing administrative workload, voize gives care teams more time for what matters most: people.

Its proprietary AI is built to handle dialects and accents, and supports grammar correction and additional AI features. voize integrates seamlessly with existing systems and is tailored specifically to everyday workflows in care settings. Developed in Germany and fully GDPR-compliant, voize is already used by more than 1,500 care facilities and supports over 100,000 caregivers every day.
